question.problem:
Which of the following equations has no solutions?

I. $2x-3=2x+4$

II. $-5x+7=-2x-2$

III. $4x+1=4x+1$
question.worked_solution:
Let's attempt to solve each equation in turn:

- For the first equation, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}2x-3 & =2x+4 \\ 2x-3-2x & =2x+4-2x \\ -3 & =4.\end{aligned}
$$

This equation is false for all values of $x.$ Therefore, the equation $2x-3=2x+4$ has no solutions.

- For the second equation, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}-5x+7 & =-2x-2 \\ -5x+7+2x-7 & =-2x-2+2x-7 \\ -3x & =-9 \\ x & =3.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the equation $-5x+7=-2x-2$ has the unique solution $x=3.$

- For the third equation, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}4x+1 & =4x+1 \\ 4x+1-4x & =4x+1-4x \\ 1 & =1.\end{aligned}
$$

This equation is true for all values of $x.$

Therefore, the correct answer is "I only."
